Robust ODE model of track length versus replication percentage

Source: R/track_velocity.R
fit_track_velocity_ode.Rd

Fit the closed-form solution of the ODE d log L / dx = alpha + beta * exp(gamma * (x - rep_center)), log L(x) = log_L_ref + alpha * d + beta / gamma * expm1(gamma * d) with d = x - rep_center, by robust nonlinear regression (robustbase::nlrob(method = "M"), beta and gamma on the log scale) and optionally by median regression (quantreg::nlrq(), started at the robust estimates). Starting values come from a robust quadratic fit (gamma = 0.03, beta = max(2 * b2 / gamma, 1e-4), alpha = b1 - beta).

Usage

fit_track_velocity_ode(
  data,
  rep_center = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  n_grid = 100L,
  level = 0.95,
  quantile = TRUE,
  holdout_prop = 0.5,
  seed = 2026L,
  fit_seed = NULL,
  maxiter = 500L
)

Arguments

data

Output of summarize_track_lengths() (rep_percent, median_length, log_length).

rep_center

Centre of the parameterisation; default: median of data$rep_percent.

start

NULL (computed) or a named list of starting values (log_L_ref, alpha, log_beta, log_gamma).

n_grid

Number of prediction points (e.g. 100 or 200).

level

Confidence level of the intervals.

quantile

Logical; also fit the median regression (needs quantreg).

holdout_prop

Fraction of cells used for training in the hold-out validation (floor(holdout_prop * n)).

seed

Seed of the hold-out split.

fit_seed

NULL or a seed for the full-data fits (see Details).

maxiter

maxiter of stats::nls.control() for nlrob().

Value

An object of class scrt_track_velocity (a list) with model = "ode", rep_center, start, fit_ode, fit_nlrq, parameters (rep_center, log_L_ref, alpha, beta, gamma), data (with is_outlier), residuals, prediction (all grid rows), velocity (rows with positive velocity), validation, validation_metrics, rse, pseudo_r2, turning_rep_percent, minimal_predicted_length and rep_range.

Details

Predictions on an even grid get delta-method confidence intervals and prediction intervals with qnorm((1 + level) / 2); the length velocity is L(x) * (alpha + beta * exp(gamma * d)). A random hold-out split refits the model (with rep_center of the full data) and reports RMSE, pseudo-R2 and correlation on the test cells.
